title: Display switcher and toolbar icons in Tech View and Board View match the design
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-A} (for example Admin ShopView), an Owner or Admin user whose role has Work orders > View, Work orders > Create & Edit and See financial data, at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
  • Your browser window is 1440 px wide, with the browser zoom at 100%.
  • The design pictures DC-01-toolbar-tech-view-light-1440.png and DC-01-toolbar-board-view-light-1440.png are open beside the app at 100% zoom (actual size); they are attached to this case.
  • In the design pictures the names, numbers, dates and amounts are sample data, and the rank numbers (1, 2, 3 …) beside rows and cards are left out of this release, so do not compare those.
  • Technician {Technician-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST DC01 Ana Icons) is an active technician at {Location-A}.
  • Customer {Customer-A} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST DC01 Toolbar Icons") is used by this case only.
  • Approved work order {Work-order-1} (for example S10043-17801) for {Customer-A} is led by {Technician-A}.
  • On the Work Orders page nothing is chosen in any filter, Assigned to me is off, Search is empty and density is Regular (the default).
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders from the top menu and click the All tab.
  2. Click List in the display switcher at the right of the toolbar.
  3. Look at the three buttons of the display switcher.
  4. Click Tech View in the display switcher.
  5. Look at the display switcher, the density button and the column chooser button, and compare them with the Tech View design picture.
  6. Click the density button.
  7. Look at the menu that opens.
  8. Press Escape.
  9. Click Board View in the display switcher.
  10. Look at the display switcher and the density button, and compare them with the Board View design picture.
  11. Click List in the display switcher.
  12. Look at the other icons in List's toolbar.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: the switcher shows three outline icons side by side in a light-grey rounded track: a bulleted list (List), the head and shoulders of a person (Tech View) and a square board with three bars of different lengths (Board View), the same three drawings as in the design pictures and about the same size as in the pictures at 100% zoom (20 px in the PRD). They are thin-line outline icons of the same weight, not filled icons, emoji or text characters.
  • Step 5: the Tech View button sits on a white raised segment and the other two look flat. The density button shows three lines with an up-and-down arrow at their right (the design's "row-height" icon) and the column chooser button shows a rectangle split into three columns (the design's "columns-3" icon), drawn in the same thin outline style, as in the Tech View picture.
  • Step 7: the density menu offers Compact, Regular and Comfortable, with Regular marked as the one in use.
  • Step 10: the Board View button is now the white raised segment, and the density button shows a different drawing from Tech View's: a card with an up-and-down arrow (the design's "card-height" icon), as in the Board View picture.
  • Step 12: the other icons in List's toolbar look the same as in List in production today; only the display switcher is new.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; stories SV-10044 (Story 1, Switch between display options), SV-10049 (Story 6, Density); PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 52 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S1-R9a, S1-R9, S6-R1 and Goals, read 14 Oct 2026; Claude Design project "Work Orders" (Branko Cicovic), export of 14 Oct 2026, board "Work Orders.dc.html", states states__work-orders__tech-density-menu__light__1440 and core__work-orders__board-detailed__light__1440 (design pictures DC-01-toolbar-tech-view-light-1440.png, DC-01-toolbar-board-view-light-1440.png, rendered from that export at the width in the name), read 14 Oct 2026. Covers the design defects SV-11319 (reported 14 Oct 2026 by Chris Ward). Where the PRD says nothing about the look, the design is the source. Source-verified 14 October 2026. Not yet checked against a build.

The design names the three options Table, By Lead Tech and Board; this case follows the PRD's names List, Tech View and Board View (question W-1 to the product owner, not yet answered). Whether the filter chips also take the design's icons is a separate open question (PQ-V01), so this case does not judge the chip icons.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R9a: “The switcher uses the design’s icons at 20px: List is Lucide `list`, Tech View is `user-round`, Board View is `square-kanban`. In Tech View and Board View every other icon is the design’s Lucide icon too: density (`row-height` in Tech View, `card-height` in Board View), collapse chevron (`chevron-down`), pin and unpin (`pin` / `pin-off`), Invoiced or Paid lock (`lock`), Unassigned avatar (`user-round`) and empty states (`clipboard-list`). List’s icons are unchanged.”
  • S1-R9: “The switcher visually indicates the active display option.”
  • S6-R1: “Offer Compact, Regular, and Comfortable density in Tech View and Board View.”
  • Goals: “List remains the default and is unchanged from production; the only addition to the Work Orders page is the display switcher.”
  • Design — _ds_bundle.js (design library), density button icon: “name: kanban ? 'card-height' : 'row-height',”
  • Design — _ds_bundle.js (design library), column chooser button icon: “window.svIcon("columns-3", 20)”
  • Design — README.md (design library), icons: “Never emoji. Never a unicode glyph as an icon.”
